Route Mobile and Truecaller Announce Business Messaging Partnership

Route Mobile's share price saw a significant increase following the announcement of a new partnership with Truecaller. The collaboration is designed to enhance Route Mobile's Business Messaging platform by integrating Truecaller's user base and messaging features. This aims to facilitate more secure and engaging customer interactions across different media formats.
